correctness.rationale: For balanced words with at least two symbols of each type, the graph irreducibility characterization excludes the four degeneracies and the surviving self-loop makes its integral adjacency primitive. Its Perron root is a nonrational algebraic integer in \((1,2)\) and has strictly smaller conjugates, so no positive power is rational. Direct differentiation of the exact weighted correlation generating function yields rho-1/2 equal to the imbalance polynomial divided by a nonzero negative denominator. One or two distinct nonzero integer terms cannot cancel because that would make a positive power of \(\lambda\) rational. For w_m the two border lengths were classified and the sign follows. Finite independent transfer-matrix checks ran successfully; no finite-to-infinite inference is used.

value.rationale: The explicit mixed-sign example identified as outside the motivating 2026 theorem is settled with strict bias, and the construction \(w_m=10001\,0^m\,1^{m+2}\,10001\) gives infinitely many such words. The structural Perron-power obstruction proves an entire motivated subcase of an expressly posed conjecture, not an arbitrary finite census or simple parameter change. The remaining cases with >=3 nonzero borders and the independent stopped-process q condition are transparently unresolved.
